description: This file defines the NodeListBuilder class in Drupal, responsible for building a listing of node entities with headers and rows, including details like title, type, author, status, update time, and language.

classes.name: NodeListBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds a listing of node entities, providing headers and rows with node details such as title, type, author, status, last changed time, and language.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NodeListBuilder with entity type, storage, date formatter, and redirect destination services.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of NodeListBuilder using dependency injection container.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the node listing table, including columns for title, content type, author, status, updated time, and language if multilingual.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a data row for a given node entity, including title link, content type, author, publication status, last changed time, language, and operations.
